title: Chapter 88 Gong Zheng'S Transformation
content:
Chapter 88 Gong Zheng'S Transformation

"Hey, brat, now you don't have to go out and earn military merit points yourself. Isn't it great?"

Zhao Bangde said with a smile when he saw Wang Shuo.

"Old Zhao, please stop teasing me! I'm really at a loss for what to do now!"

"When building a village, you have to do it yourself in the early stages. There is no way around it."

"Lord." Ayub also returned to the Yellow Wind Valley camp at this time.

Seeing them all return, Wang Shuo nodded and said with a smile: "Thank you for your hard work!"

"It is our unshirkable responsibility to fight on the battlefield for the lord."

"Okay, let me see your results today."

After Wang Shuo checked it, he showed a satisfied smile.

There are a total of 21,200 military merit points.

Wang Shuo thought for a moment and did not choose to summon a tool man this time. After all, tool men below level 5 would not play a big role in tomorrow's battle.

After rummaging carefully, Wang Shuo selected 3 things.

A set of heavy armor, worth 6,000 military merit points; a summoning token, worth 10,000 military merit points; and a shield, worth 5,000 military merit points.

[Rock Armor: Gold level heavy armor, defense +60, constitution +100, durability 200/200. 】

A very simple introduction, compared with the properties of chain armor, it is not inferior, and it is quite suitable for Gong Zheng.

[Body Protection Gang Shield: Gold-level shield, constitution +50, defense +50, skill: Gang Qi Body Protection. After the skill is activated, a Gang Qi shield can be released covering the whole body, so that there are no weaknesses in the whole body, and no part of the body is affected by damage. The damage is deducted from the same health points, there is no skill CD, and 10 points of mental power are consumed every minute. Durability 100/100. 】

This shield, armor, and petrification skills are a perfect combination!

It is completely possible to arm Gong Zheng into a strong steel boss that can face him.

Wang Shuo believes that a boss will definitely appear tomorrow, and Gong Zheng is the secret weapon he has prepared.

Return to the territory, the meeting hall.

Wang Shuo quickly handed the shield and skill book to Gong Zheng.

[ID: SAC56789536 Gong Zheng]

[Level: Level 14]

[Attribution: Wana Village]

[Loyalty: 100/100]

[Combat Occupation: Cavalry]

【Strength: 27】

[Physique: 45+150]

[Agility: 16]

[Energy: 15]

(Qualification: B level, each level provides 4 free attribute points.)

[Combat attribute panel]

[Attack power: 27]

[Defense: 110]

[Health value: 3450]

[Kung Fu: Diamond Technique]

[Skills: 1. Block, 2. Petrify, 3. Damage rebound (not learned), 4. Life feedback (not learned). 】

[Equipment: 1. Rock armor, (bronze hammer with two hands) 2. Body shield, 3. Crocodile leather boots, 4. Bronze helmet]

[Evaluation: He is no longer a qualified cavalryman, he should be a piece of iron fool. 】

After fighting for most of the day on the ancient battlefield, his level had been raised to level 14, which was higher than Wang Shuo. At the same time, Wang Shuo also chose a "Diamond Technique" for him from among the techniques obtained in the dungeon.

[Diamond Technique: Yellow-level skill, with seven levels in total. Each level provides all attributes +1, constitution +10, and defense +10. Skills: 1. Damage rebound. After activation, 80% of the damage can be rebounded. Skill CD: 5 minutes, consuming 50 points of mental power. 2. Life feedback, a passive skill that recovers 1% of the total damage received every minute. 】

Wang Shuo was quite excited when he saw his attribute panel.

This is simply an invincible Xiaoqiang.

Moreover, he also has the bond of "Brothers Together", which can increase his health, attack power and defense power by 30%.

Invincible.
